items.title: Show HN: Sphinx – a hook that quizzes you on your AI's code before shipping
items.desc: FOSS, Basically it plugs into your existing coding agent workflow and every time you push to prod it'll throw up a questionnaire that checks if you understand how the code you're pushing works.
items.author: critiquebrowser
items.descZh: FOSS 是一款面向开发团队的代码审查辅助工具，它通过嵌入现有的编码工作流，在每次代码部署到生产环境时自动触发一个问卷调查，核心功能是检验提交者对所推送代码的实际理解程度，防止因不熟悉代码而盲目提交。其亮点在于将代码审查从形式化流程转化为实质性的知识确认，通过强制性的理解问答来提升代码质量和团队协作效率。这种机制尤其适合需要严格把控上线质量的团队，或者在快速迭代中容易出现“只写不读”现象的开发环境。
items.quote: 基本上，它会插入您现有的编码代理工作流程，每次您推送产品时，它都会弹出一份调查问卷，检查您是否了解
items.titleZh: Show HN：Sphinx – 一个在发货前询问你的 AI 代码的钩子

items.title: Show HN: 500 clocks in one 6.3 MB HTML file by Opus 5.5
items.desc: Lately I've been testing frontier models by having them create self-contained web pages that display clocks--sort of my personal version of Simon Willison’s pelican-on-a-bicycle metric. I have been particularly impressed by the variety, interest, and quality of the clocks created by Claude Opus
items.author: tkgally
items.descZh: 背景：作者采用让前沿 AI 模型生成自包含时钟网页的方式，作为评估其多模态能力与创造力的非正式基准。核心功能：模型需独立编写 HTML、CSS 和 JavaScript，实现一个视觉上完整且可运行的时钟界面。亮点：Claude Opus 在该任务中展现出的多样性、趣味性与成品质量远超其他模型，其生成的时钟在创意和完成度上均表现优异。适用场景：该测试方法适用于横向对比不同大模型的代码生成、UI 设计与创意整合能力。
items.quote: Claude Opus 创建的时钟在多样性、趣味性和质量方面尤其令我印象深刻。

[](install) [](install) [](whatitreadsrunsandkeeps) [](/ahmtsahin/claudeenvtabs/blob/main/LICENSE) Demo projects. The pictures are drawn by [docs/demo/render.mjs](/ahmtsahin/claudeenvtabs/blob/main/docs/demo/render.mjs) with the mod's own icons and colors. Why The Code tab's sidebar sorts its folder groups by itself, by recent activity or A to Z, and there is no way to keep the projects you use most at the top. Plenty of people have asked for one, on Windows and on macOS: [70104](https://github.com/anthropics/claudecode/issues/70104), [66196](https://github.com/anthropics/claudecode/issues/66196), [102088](https://github.com/anthropics/claudecode/issues/102088). Neither a mod nor Claude can pin a folder group in the app's sidebar, so envtabs draws a Projects pane of its own beside the conversation, and tabs above the prompt. Your sessions are not moved or filed anywhere: the app's sidebar stays exactly as it is. What you get A Projects pane, pinned projects on top Pinned projects stay on top, in the order of their tabs. Every other recent project follows, the latest first. Every project has an icon: its first letter on a color of its own, which a rename keeps. The project you are in is highlighted. Click a project to show or hide its sessions, click a session to open it. Point at a project's row for \+ New, which starts a session in that folder, and Pin or Unpin. Projects are folders, like in the sidebar: a project inside a pinned folder keeps its own row, and a session in one of a repository's worktrees is listed under the repository. This computer gathers the sessions you started without choosing a folder. Session states, like the sidebar's dots State What it means [](/ahmtsahin/claudeenvtabs/blob/main/docs/images/dotwaiting.svg) Waiting for you The session needs a permission or an answer. [](/ahmtsahin/claudeenvtabs/blob/main/docs/images/dotunread.svg) Unread It finished after you last looked at it. [](/ahmtsahin/claudeenvtabs/blob/main/docs/images/dotrunning.svg) Running Claude is working; the dot pulses. [](/ahmtsahin/claudeenvtabs/blob/main/docs/images/dotidle.svg) Idle Nothing new. A project's row and its tab count the sessions that need you: the ones waiting for you or unread, in amber while one waits. A project with a session running and nothing to count shows the running dot. The states refresh every few seconds, and the session you are in is never shown as unread. A tab above the prompt for every pinned project One click opens the project's latest session, or starts one in its folder when it has none yet. The tab of the project you are in is filled, and every tab carries the project's icon and its count. In a project you have not pinned, \+ Pin this folder pins it right there; Projects opens the pane. Install At the prompt of a terminal session: /plugin install envtabs marketplace ahmtsahin/claudeenvtabs Or from a shell: claude plugin install envtabs marketplace ahmtsahin/claudeenvtabs Answer y to add the marketplace and pick the user scope, so the pane and the tabs show in every session. In the desktop app, where /plugin does not run: click + next to the prompt box, then Plugins, Add marketplace with ahmtsahin/claudeenvtabs, then Add plugin. Note Requires Claude Desktop with mod support. Built and tested on Windows 11 with Claude Desktop (Claude Code engine 2.1.299). macOS runs the same code, openi
items.author: impala64
items.descZh: 针对 Claude Desktop 侧边栏无法固定高频项目的痛点，envtabs 插件提供了一套非侵入式的项目组织方案，在不改变原有侧边栏布局的前提下，新增了一个可固定项目的“Projects”面板和提示词上方的快捷标签页。其核心功能是支持将常用项目置顶展示（按标签页顺序排列），并提供一键点击打开最新会话或新建项目的便捷操作。亮点在于实时的会话状态同步（包括等待、未读、运行和空闲，每几秒刷新一次），并通过琥珀色数字直观提示待处理会话数，同时自动为项目生成独特的彩色字母图标并支持 Git worktree。该插件完美兼容 Windows 11 及 Claude Code 引擎 2.1.299 环境，非常适合需要频繁在多个并行项目与 AI 会话间高效切换的开发者使用。
items.quote: 您的会话不会被移动或归档到任何地方：应用的侧边栏完全保持原样。

One purchase covers up to 3 Macs. If you prefer to build it yourself, the source is MIT licensed and the source build needs no purchase key. [](https://www.asdftq.com/nobadge/) What it does Follow any Focus, or only the modes you choose. Hide supported badges in the Dock and app switcher. Hide the separate System Settings Dock badge on macOS 27, with the same exceptions and restoration. Keep badges visible for individual apps. Show badges for 15 minutes without switching Focus off. Restore the badge settings NoBadge changed when Focus ends. Version 0.1.42 fixes a Focustransition race that could leave badges hidden after Focus ended. Keep Hide automatically during Focus enabled and choose Any Focus for normal on/off syncing. No manual restore is needed when Focus ends. Restore previous settings temporarily shows badges for 15 minutes; Resume now ends that pause early. Before you run it Compatibility: Apple Silicon on macOS 26.5.1 or later in macOS 26, and macOS 27. NoBadge selects the adapter for your OS family and checks the settings format before changing badges. Stable minor and patch updates within these families do not need a new buildnumber approval. macOS 28 and later, beta builds, Intel Macs and older macOS versions need a compatible release. Directly verified builds: macOS 26.5.1 (25F80), 26.6 (25G72) and 27.0.1 (26A434). A supported family is not a claim that every build has been tested. If Apple changes the settings format, NoBadge pauses changes and keeps recovery information. NoBadge requires Full Disk Access because it reads private macOS Focus settings and changes notification preferences. This is a broad permission. The app does not read messages or documents, and badge/Focus processing stays on your Mac. Some apps draw their own badges and may not respond. Quit any running NoBadge copy before using another build. Use Restore & Quit before removing or replacing it. If it is forcequit, reopen it to restore pending settings. Badge support Badge path macOS 26.5.1+ within 26 macOS 27 Registered notification badges Supported Supported System Settings Dock attention badge Not supported Supported since 0.1.41 Other custom appdrawn badges Not guaranteed Not guaranteed System Settings uses a separate, journaled adapter. Version 0.1.41 fixes a storageselection bug in 0.1.40 that could leave its Dock badge visible. It follows Focus, Show badges, app exceptions and safe exit/update restoration. It preserves current external attention entries; it does not resolve the underlying system requests or hide notices inside System Settings. Supported adapters are declared per OS family. Unknown settings formats pause changes rather than reporting a successful hide. Build from source You need a Mac with a current Xcode installation and Python 3. git clone https://github.com/asdftq/NoBadge.git cd NoBadge ./scripts/buildsource.sh The app is written to: build/SourceData/Build/Products/Release/NoBadge.app The script generates the Xcode project

items.descZh: NoBadge 是一款针对 macOS 系统的实用工具，旨在解决 Focus 模式下 Dock 栏和应用切换器徽章带来的视觉干扰问题。其核心功能是自动隐藏 Focus 模式开启时的受支持徽章，并在模式结束后无缝恢复原有设置，无需用户手动干预。亮点在于提供精细化控制，支持全 Focus 或指定模式隐藏、单应用例外保持可见，以及临时展示 15 分钟徽章的弹性选项；版本 0.1.42 修复了 Focus 切换的竞争问题，0.1.41 修正了系统设置 Dock 徽章的存储选择 bug。该工具需要 Full Disk Access 权限以读取私有 Focus 设置，兼容 Apple Silicon 设备运行的 macOS 26.5.1 及以上、macOS 27 系统，也提供开源构建方案。它特别适合追求专注体验、希望减少数字干扰的 macOS 用户，尤其是频繁使用 Focus 模式的生产力人群。

items.author: singhvir943
items.descZh: HardwareOS是一个革命性的平台，旨在解决硬件创意从概念到实物的转化难题，它通过集成化工具将模糊的想法转化为可执行的构建计划。核心功能允许用户用自然语言描述设备需求，系统自动从目录中选取零件、规划接线路径，并生成可编译的固件代码，实现从设计到制造的无缝衔接。亮点在于其庞大的数据库支持，索引了超过4000种电路板和20000种零件，提供3000多种预验证接线方案，确保构建过程高效且可靠。适用场景广泛，包括教育学习、产品原型开发、个人项目以及专业研发，覆盖从初学者到资深工程师的各类用户群体。
